text: Skolemization eliminates the existential quantifier in ∀x ∃y P(x, y) by:
choices: deleting ∃y and leaving y as a free variable
replacing y with a new function symbol applied to the governing universal variables, e.g. P(x, f(x))
replacing y with a single fresh constant, e.g. P(x, c), in every case
swapping the quantifiers to ∃y ∀x P(x, y)
explanation: Skolemization replaces the existentially quantified variable by a Skolem FUNCTION of the universal variables it depends on: ∀x∃y P(x,y) becomes ∀x P(x, f(x)). A bare constant (option 3) only works when the ∃ lies inside no ∀; leaving y free (option 1) or swapping quantifiers (option 4) changes the meaning. Skolemization preserves satisfiability, not logical equivalence.
